decisions.rationale: 'enzyme deficiency' is a general term built on the excluded word 'deficiency' and does not name one specific disease or a disease family.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 - Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: 'hemolytic anemia' denotes a family of multiple specific anemias involving hemolysis rather than one specific disease definition.
The contiguous span names the single specific disease G6PD deficiency; the candidate span is kept as given.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; What to Annotate 5 - Minimum necessary span

decisions.rationale: 'genetic abnormality' is a very general term; 'abnormality' is explicitly excluded and does not name a specific disease or class.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 - Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: Repeated occurrence of the general term 'enzyme deficiency', which is excluded as a general term regardless of repetition.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 - Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD Mediterranean' names a specific variant form of G6PD deficiency with its own definition, analogous to classical galactosemia.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 15 - particular form of a disease

decisions.rationale: 'favism' is a single named disease (acute hemolytic reaction to fava beans) with no further categorization.
'G6PD Metaponto' names a specific G6PD variant form with its own definition, even though it is described as asymptomatic.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 15 - particular form of a disease

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD Ilesha' names a specific G6PD variant form with its own definition, even though it is described as asymptomatic.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 15 - particular form of a disease

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD Chatham' names a specific G6PD variant form that is observed in a patient with neonatal jaundice.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 15 - particular form of a disease

decisions.rationale: 'neonatal jaundice' is a single well-defined neonatal condition, not a family of diseases or a general term.
The quoted name 'Matera' denotes the specific G6PD variant G6PD Matera, a distinct specific form of the disease; the candidate span is kept as given.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; What to Annotate 5 - Minimum necessary span

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD A-' names the specific deficient variant of G6PD deficiency, identified as the same as G6PD Matera.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 15 - particular form of a disease

decisions.rationale: 'G6PD Santiago' names a specific G6PD variant form that is associated with a de novo mutation and severe hemolytic anemia.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 15 - particular form of a disease

decisions.rationale: 'chronic hemolytic anemia' is a category of anemias encompassing multiple specific diseases rather than one specific definition.
'G6PD deficiency' names the single specific disease G6PD deficiency, with no further categorization.
